name: Validate DevBob Container
description: Validate devbob-clean Docker container configuration (OpenCode installation, code sync, ACP server, MCP tools)

task_steps.description: Check devbob-clean container status (running, healthy, uptime)

prompt.template:
Check the Docker container status for devbob-clean:

1. Run: docker ps --filter name=devbob-clean --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.State}}'
2. Check uptime and health status
3. Report:
   - Container state (running/stopped)
   - Health status
   - Uptime duration
   - Any restart issues

Provide a clear status summary.

task_steps.description: Verify OpenCode CLI is installed and functional in devbob-clean

prompt.template:
Verify OpenCode installation in devbob-clean container:

1. Run: docker exec devbob-clean which opencode
2. Run: docker exec devbob-clean opencode --version
3. Check installation path and version
4. Report:
   - Installation status (installed/missing)
   - Binary path
   - Version number
   - Any errors

Provide installation verification summary.

task_steps.description: Verify code sync between host and devbob-clean container

prompt.template:
Verify code sync in devbob-clean container:

1. Run: docker exec devbob-clean ls -la /workspace
2. Run: docker exec devbob-clean git -C /workspace status
3. Check:
   - /workspace directory exists
   - Git repository is accessible
   - Code files are present
   - No permission issues
4. Report:
   - Sync status (synced/missing)
   - File count in /workspace
   - Git status
   - Any permission errors

Provide code sync verification summary.

task_steps.description: Verify ACP server is running in devbob-clean

prompt.template:
Verify ACP server in devbob-clean container:

1. Run: docker exec devbob-clean ps aux | grep 'opencode acp'
2. Run: docker exec devbob-clean netstat -tuln | grep 3000 || ss -tuln | grep 3000
3. Check:
   - ACP server process is running
   - Port 3000 is listening
   - No startup errors
4. Report:
   - Server status (running/stopped)
   - Process ID
   - Port binding status
   - Any errors

Provide ACP server verification summary.

task_steps.description: Verify Metabob MCP tools are configured in devbob-clean

prompt.template:
Verify MCP tools configuration in devbob-clean:

1. Run: docker exec devbob-clean cat /workspace/opencode.json | grep -A 10 '"mcp"'
2. Check:
   - opencode.json exists
   - MCP configuration is present
   - Metabob MCP client is configured
   - Configuration is valid JSON
3. Report:
   - Configuration status (configured/missing)
   - MCP client details
   - Any configuration errors

Provide MCP tools verification summary.

Generate validation report for devbob-clean container:

Summarize all validation results:
1. Container Status: [running/stopped, healthy/unhealthy]
2. OpenCode Installation: [version, status]
3. Code Sync: [synced/missing, file count]
4. ACP Server: [running/stopped, port status]
5. MCP Tools: [configured/missing]

Overall Assessment:
- ✅ PASS: All checks successful
- ⚠️ WARNING: Minor issues found
- ❌ FAIL: Critical issues found

Recommendations:
- List any required fixes
- Suggest improvements

Create report file: test-results/devbob-container-validation.md
